title: Reign in Us
lyrics: Verse 1:
You [Am]thought of us before the world be[F]gan to breathe.
You [G/B]knew our names before we came to [C]be.[G/B]
You [Am]saw the very day we'd fall a[F]way from you,
And how [G/B]desperately we need to be [C]redeemed.[G/B]
Pre-Chorus 1:
Lord [F]Jesus, come [G]lead us;
We're [Dm]desperate for your [G]touch.
Chorus 1:
[C]Oh Great and Mighty One,[G] with one desire we come,
[Dm]That you[Am] would reign,[F] that you would [G]reign in us.
[C]We're offering up our lives,[G] a living sacrifice,
[Dm]That you[Am] would reign,[F] that you would [G]reign in us.
Verse 2:
Spirit of the Living God, fall fresh again,
Come search our hearts and purify our lives.
We need your perfect love;
We need your discipline.
We're lost unless you guide us with your light.
Bridge 1:
We [G]cry out for your [F]love to re[C]fine us,
Cry out[G] for your [F]love to de[C]fine us,
Cry out[G] for your [F]mercy to [C]keep us
[Am]blameless until You return.[G]
Bridge 2:
So[F] reign, please [C]reign in [G]us.
Come [Am]purify our [F]hearts; we [C]need your [G]touch.
Come [Am]cleanse us like a [F]flood and [C]send us [G]out
So the [Am]world may know you [F]reign, you [C]reign in [G]us.
